comment: integration test - a real child di.torq.proc.discovery wired to di.timer / di.torq.handlers / di.util.log / di.torq.servers; plain-q backends for it to find; real subscriber children on di.torq.servers
requires QPATH resolving the di.* modules (the children run the same kdb-x binary as this session); skips cleanly if no child comes up
child ports are OS-assigned; every child pid is killed by the after row; run from the repo root in a fresh q session
fixture dir; TORQXAPPHOME/TORQXDATAHOME for the children
skip cleanly when no child kdb-x process can be started
two backends in process.csv are dialled and reported live within the first ticks - the discovery row is never handed out - identity and settings reached the module

a backend added to process.csv after startup (beside an operator's garbage line) is found on the next tick and pushed to an ALL subscriber - a dead backend leaves the live view and returns when restarted
two discovery instances dial each other but never hand a discovery row out - a subscriber to either is served
a process removed from process.csv while still running is evicted from discovery and from an ALL subscriber (which closes its handle) - it returns when the line is restored
the consumers the surface exists for
a subscriber asking for rdb over .discovery.getservices is pushed exactly the live rdb row into its .torq.servers.addprocs and its own retry connects it - an unsubscribed peer gets nothing

a process listed only in nontorqprocess.csv is tracked and pushed like any other - deleting that file evicts it from discovery and the subscriber - a file appearing after startup is warned about once then tracked - ignored with tracking off - a relative nontorqprocessfile resolves beside process.csv
a subscriber that dies is forgotten via the .z.pc observer and discovery keeps serving - a restarted subscriber re-subscribes on a new handle and is served again
a real di.torq boot through torqx_init.q with a settings cascade

di.torq launches disc1 from process.csv + discovery.toml via the builtin registry - identity and settings reach the module - the builtin settings tier gives servers hopentimeout 200 - a backend is found - clean exit
kill every child and remove the fixture dir
